title: Code, conditions and aggregate results of 'The 30-second signal changes of a hand-set keystroke state estimator before code-writing stalls'
description:
A preregistered equivalence test of whether the 30-second change in two signals of a keystroke state estimator with hand-set coefficients (the probability of its Stuck state and a smoothed friction axis) distinguishes the run-up to a stall in character production from the run-up to a short pause of 2-30 s by the same writer, on a holdout of the CS1 introductory programming keystroke data.

The archive holds the estimator and its replay tool cut out at the version used, the conversion, evaluation and exploration scripts, the conditions committed before each computation (in Japanese, with an English summary), the aggregate results, a script that reruns the holdout confirmation and checks that its result is byte-identical to the released one, and the manuscript sources. The data and per-writer values are not included.
